glosses: to destroy, to bust up, to kill

examples.text: Jesteś tu bezpieczna – powtórzył po raz kolejny Dawid, choć zapewne sam nie miał co do tego pewności. Skoro Badyl nie zeznał przeciwko niemu w sądzie, to co robiłby tu pies? Czy możliwe, żeby ktoś jeszcze rozjebał się na niego?
examples.translation: "You're safe here", David repeated once again, although he probably wasn't sure about that himself. If Badyl hadn't testified against him in court, what would the cop be doing here? Would it be possible for someone else to snitch on him?
examples.english: "You're safe here", David repeated once again, although he probably wasn't sure about that himself. If Badyl hadn't testified against him in court, what would the cop be doing here? Would it be possible for someone else to snitch on him?

examples.text: Po co rozjebałeś tak to okno?
